## Which visa

UK passport gets 45 days visa-free, but the trip is 52 days (Da Nang, Hội An, Huế, then up to Hà Giang), so I needed
the e-visa: 90 days, multiple-use, US$25 flat. Do not use the lookalike agency sites charging $80 to $120, the only
real one is evisa.gov.vn.

## Application

Applied on 12 January 2025. Needed:

- passport bio page scan (colour, no glare)
- photo 4x6, white background, no glasses
- address of the first hotel (Hoa Sen Homestay, Hội An)
- arrival airport and intended exit airport

Registration code E250112VNM48271. Keep this, it's the only way to check status.

## The photo rejection

First attempt bounced on 15 January: "portrait does not meet requirements". It was my glasses reflecting the ring
light, classic. Retook it against the white wall in the hallway, resubmitted the same evening, approved 19 January.
Three working days the second time.

## Arrival

Landed at Da Nang (DAD) on VietJet VJ 641 from Bangkok on 3 March. Printed the approval PDF twice, the officer took
one copy and stamped me through in about six minutes. The arrival airport has to match what you typed in the form,
so double check that field.

## Next time

- Insurance with medical evacuation, I compared a few in [[Travel insurance comparison]]
- 7 hours ahead of Lisbon, so the usual plan from [[Jet lag strategy]]
- One bag only, [[Packing list carry-on]], laundry is ₫30,000 a kilo everywhere
- Bring some crisp USD notes for the first taxi, ATMs at DAD charge ₫50,000 a withdrawal
